params.prompt: Photo-real establishing shot for a Korean sitcom, 9:16 vertical, evening. Reference image 1 is the exact living room (caramel corduroy sofa, round oak coffee table with tomato-red tray, mustard armchair, marble kitchen island with black stools, oak stairs, herringbone floor, string lights, arched window): keep every piece of furniture, art and color, but make it evening: window dark navy, warm lamps and string lights on, no daylight. Wide shot from the entrance side at eye level, the sofa in the foreground-left and the kitchen island behind on the right, nobody at the island. Reference image 2 gives the two people and their exact pose: keep their faces, hair, glasses and clothes. The woman (white shirt, dark jeans) sits at the left end of the sofa with a phone, the man (navy overshirt, glasses, ID badge) at the right end, one cream knit cushion between them, both tense, not touching. People are small in the frame, the whole room reads. No text, no watermark, natural skin.
